reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001382 (the melody read from 001382a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 21); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. J. E. Kingsley has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1847, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1847, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001382a.nwc).
